login.title: Masjid Admin
login.lead: Assalamu Alaikum. Log in with your phone’s screen lock.
login.screenLockHint: Your phone will ask for your screen lock (PIN, pattern, face or fingerprint).
login.trouble: Having trouble? Contact the Masjid Connect team
login.failed: Login didn’t work. Please try again.
login.cancelled: Login was cancelled. Tap “Log in” to try again.
login.noScreenLock: Your phone needs a screen lock to log in. Set one in your phone’s settings, then try again.
login.sessionEnded: You were logged out. Please log in again.

invite.forMasjids: {count, plural, one {Admin of this masjid:} other {Admin of these masjids:}}
invite.addDeviceLead: This adds a login for this phone to your admin account.
invite.recoveryLead: Create a new login for your admin account. Your old phone will be logged out.
invite.invalidTitle: This invite link can’t be used
invite.invalidBody: It was already used or has expired. Ask the Masjid Connect team for a new link.
invite.missingBody: Open the link the Masjid Connect team sent you, on the phone you will use as admin.

undertaking.title: Before you start
undertaking.lead: Please read these points. They keep your masjid’s page trustworthy.
undertaking.agree: I have read and I agree
undertaking.outdated: This text was updated. Please close and reopen the app to read the new version.

home.title: My Masjid
home.noMasjidBody: You are not an admin of any masjid yet. The Masjid Connect team will add you.

today.unset: Prayer times are not set yet

home.readOnly: Changes are paused for a short while for maintenance. You can still see everything. Please try again later.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.body: This part of the app is being built. It will appear here in an update.

account.title: My account
account.signOutAllConfirmBody: Every phone and computer logged in to your account will be logged out, this one too.
account.passkeysLead: Each login is your screen lock on one phone.
account.addDeviceLead: Open this link on your other phone within 3 days. It works once.
account.whatsAppMessage: My Masjid Connect admin login link: {url}

timings.title: Prayer Times
timings.needAll: Set all five jamaat times so your masjid can go live.
timings.noChangeToday: Nothing changes today. The new times start on later days.
timings.conflictBody: Another admin saved new timings while you were editing. Load the latest timings and make your change again.
timings.quotaBody: You can still save. Followers will see the new times when they open the app.
timings.savedQuiet: Followers will see the new times.

special.title: Special Dates & Ramadan
special.ramadanHint: During these days followers see Sehri and Iftar times on their Home screen.
special.minutes: {minutes, plural, =0 {No change} one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
special.previewToday: With these settings today: Sehri ends {sehri} · Iftar {iftar}
special.disclaimer: Followers are told to follow your masjid’s announcement if it differs.

ramadanIssue.end_before_start: The last day is before the first day.
ramadanIssue.too_long: Ramadan mode can be on for at most 30 days.
ramadanIssue.date_out_of_range: Choose dates within a year from today.

special.emptyBody: Add Eid, Taraweeh or another day with special times.
special.label: Short title

issue.date_out_of_range: Choose a date within a year from today.

special.savedQuiet: Followers will see it in Special Dates.
special.deleteBody: Followers will no longer see it.
special.quotaBody: You can still save. Followers will see it when they open the app.

notice.title: Notice
notice.noTemplatesBody: You can still write your own notice.
notice.rights: This masjid owns this photo or may share it
notice.rightsHint: Photos of people only with their permission.

issue.title: Please write a title (up to 80 letters).
issue.body: Please write the message (up to 1,000 letters).
issue.event: Please set both the date and the time of the event.
issue.template: This notice is no longer available. Please choose another one.
issue.voiceTitle: Please give the voice note a title.

notice.previewNote: Followers see the photo when they open the notice.
notice.publishedNotified: {count, plural, one {# person will be notified.} other {# people will be notified.}}
notice.publishedQuiet: Followers will see it in the app.
notice.quotaBody: You can still publish. Followers will see it when they open the app.

daily.title: Hadith / Ayah
daily.todayHadith: You already shared a hadith today. If you publish another, followers will see both.
daily.todayAyah: You already shared an ayah today. If you publish another, followers will see both.
daily.noneHadith: No hadith in the library yet
daily.noneAyah: No ayah in the library yet
daily.noneBody: The Masjid Connect team adds checked hadith and ayat. Please look again later.
daily.noResultsBody: Try other words or another topic.
daily.noteHint: Optional. A few words for your followers.
daily.lostBody: Please choose the hadith or ayah again.

dua.title: Dua Request
dua.name: Name
dua.nameHint: Share a name only if the family agrees.
dua.privateHint: Followers see “a brother or sister from our community”.
dua.janazaOptional: Optional — the time and place of the janaza.

issue.message: Please write the message (up to 500 characters).
issue.name: The name is too long (up to 80 characters).
issue.janaza: Please set both the janaza date and time, or neither.
issue.voiceTitle: Please give the voice note a title.

dua.attachHint: Followers see this dua under your request.
dua.noDuas: No dua for this in the library yet
dua.noDuasBody: The Masjid Connect team adds checked duas. Please look again later.
dua.lostBody: Please choose who the dua is for again.

posts.title: My Posts
posts.removedHint: Posts that break the content policy are removed. Followers no longer see them.
posts.deleteBody: Followers will no longer see it.
posts.emptyBody: Notices, hadith and dua requests you publish appear here.
posts.savedBody: Followers see the change in the app, marked “edited”.
posts.staleBody: Someone saved it after you opened it. Please open it again from My Posts.
posts.hiddenHint: Many people reported this post, so it is hidden while the app team checks it. You don't need to do anything.

category.off_topic: Not about religion or the community

profile.title: Masjid Profile
profile.requestHint: The Masjid Connect team checks and changes names and addresses.
profile.requestSent: Sent to the Masjid Connect team
profile.hijriHint: Adjust it if the moon was seen a day earlier or later here.

voice.title: Voice note
voice.optional: A voice note is optional — up to 10 minutes.
voice.denied: The microphone is not allowed. Allow it in the browser settings, or choose an audio file.
voice.tooLong: Voice notes can be at most 10 minutes long.
voice.unreadable: This file cannot be played here. Please choose another one.
voice.rights: This masjid recorded this or may share it
voice.rightsHint: Record other people only with their permission.
voice.voiceTitleHint: One line: what the voice note is about.
voice.issue: Please give the voice note a title.

adhkar.title: Adhkar after salah
adhkar.showHint: Musallis see a card on Home for 30 minutes after each salah.
adhkar.noneBody: Add dhikr from the verified library.
adhkar.noDhikrBody: The Super Admin adds them to the library.

ruqyah.title: Ruqyah
ruqyah.intro: Musallis see these under the same headings, in this order.
ruqyah.emptyBody: Add from the verified library, type your own text, or record audio.

sourceHint.library: A verified entry with its source
sourceHint.text: Arabic and a translation — shown as added by your masjid
sourceHint.audio: Up to 10 minutes, with a title

ruqyah.libraryGone: No longer in the library — choose another
ruqyah.deleteBody: Musallis will no longer see it.
ruqyah.sourceQuestion: What do you want to add?
ruqyah.referenceHint: Where it is from, if you know
ruqyah.instructionsHint: For example, when to recite or listen

contacts.title: Ilm contacts
contacts.intro: People musallis can message on WhatsApp for Islamic questions and advice.
contacts.full: You have {max} contacts, the most allowed. Remove one to add another.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.consent: This person agreed to be listed — their name and WhatsApp will be visible to app users
contacts.consentHint: Ask them first. If they ask to be removed later, remove the contact.
contacts.deleteBody: Musallis will no longer see this person.

bloodCamp.unavailableTitle: The blood camp notice is not ready yet
bloodCamp.unavailableBody: Please ask the Super Admin to switch on the "Blood donation camp" ready notice.

push.reach: Will notify {count, plural, =0 {no one yet} one {# person} other {# people}} · {left} of {limit} left today
push.paused: Notifications are temporarily paused. Your post goes out now; notifications follow when they resume.
push.historyEmpty: No notifications yet. Each post you publish with “Notify followers” shows here.
push.counts: {sent, plural, one {Sent to # person} other {Sent to # people}} · {failed, plural, =0 {none failed} other {# failed}}
push.targeted: {count, plural, =0 {No followers with notifications on} one {For # person} other {For # people}}
push.alertsHint: Get an alert here when something needs you (for example a security check).
push.alertsOn: Alerts are on for this phone.
push.alertsBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this app in the phone settings.
push.alertsInstallFirst: On iPhone, alerts work only in the installed app.
push.alertsFailed: Could not change alerts. Please try again.

payment.title: UPI payment details
payment.intro: Followers pay donations straight to this UPI ID. The app never touches the money.
payment.payeeHint: As your bank shows it — UPI apps show this name before paying.
payment.scanHint: Point the camera at the masjid’s own UPI QR.
payment.scanNotUpi: This is not a UPI payment QR.
payment.scanFilled: UPI ID filled from the QR. Check the name.
payment.scanUnavailable: The camera cannot be used here. Type the UPI ID instead.
payment.warning: For safety, changes take 24 hours after approval. Followers will be told the payment details changed.
payment.sent: Sent. The Super Admin will check it.
payment.waiting: A change is waiting. You can ask again once it is decided.
payment.ownerOnly: Only an owner of the masjid can change the UPI details. Ask the owner, or the Super Admin.

status.requester_removed: Stopped — the admin who asked no longer has access. An owner can ask again.

donation.title: Donation Drive
donation.intro: Run a drive and keep the amount updated. Followers pay the masjid's UPI directly.
donation.noUpi: Set up your masjid's UPI first
donation.noUpiBody: Donations go straight to the masjid's verified UPI ID. Add it in Masjid Profile.
donation.limit: Up to 3 drives at a time. Mark one completed to start another.
donation.emptyBody: Start one for repairs, renovation, bills or helping people.
donation.notifyHint: Off unless it is news worth a notification.
donation.completeBody: Followers still see it until it closes, and you can still update the amount.

issue.title: a title
issue.dates: an end date after the start

video.title: Bayan Video
video.emptyBody: Upload a bayan to your masjid's YouTube channel, then add its link here.
video.helpBody: Upload the bayan to your masjid's YouTube channel, then copy its link.
video.pasteFailed: Could not read the copied link. Long-press the box and paste.
video.linkInvalid: This is not a YouTube video link
video.speaker: Speaker
video.sistersWarning: Anyone who has this YouTube link can watch it outside the app. Upload it as Unlisted.
video.rights: This bayan is our masjid's, or we may share it
video.rightsHint: Share only bayans your masjid is allowed to publish.
video.editHint: You can change the texts for 24 hours after publishing.
video.deleteBody: Followers will no longer see it in the app. The video itself stays on your YouTube channel.

chanda.title: Chanda
chanda.intro: Enter the total collected each week. Followers see it only when “Show chanda to followers” is on.
chanda.showHint: Followers see the weekly totals and a chart on your masjid page.
chanda.shownToast: Chanda is now shown to followers
chanda.hiddenToast: Chanda is now hidden from followers
chanda.noteHint: For example: thanks to everyone who gave
chanda.notifyHidden: Turn on “Show chanda to followers” to notify them.

needy.title: Needy people
needy.intro: People your masjid has verified as in need. Followers pay them directly by UPI — the app never touches the money.
needy.emptyBody: Add a person your masjid has verified. Ask them first.
needy.relistNote: Below the amount needed, this person is listed in the app again.
needy.closeBody: Use this when help is no longer needed. They are hidden from the app. This cannot be undone.
needy.removeBody: Use this for a mistake, or when the person asks to be removed. This cannot be undone.
needy.full: You have {max} active people, the most allowed. Close one to add another.
needy.retention: Details of fulfilled, closed and removed people are deleted after 90 days.
needy.name: Name shown in the app
needy.reasonHint: Short and respectful. No address, phone number or family names.
needy.upiHint: Money goes straight to this UPI ID. Check it with the person.
needy.scanHint: Point the camera at the person’s own UPI QR.
needy.zakatLabel: Zakat can be given to this person
needy.zakatHint: Your masjid’s statement. The app shows “Zakat-eligible”.
needy.privateHint: Only admins of this masjid see this. It is stored encrypted and never shown in the app.
needy.showPrivateHint: Each time someone views them, it is recorded.
needy.consent: The person — or a guardian for a child — agreed to be listed with these details
needy.consentHint: Ask them first. Their name, reason and UPI ID will be visible to app users.
